author: NorthEast News Desk
body: OpenAI says it is deepening work with Samsung Electronics on next-generation chips as the companies expand cooperation around artificial intelligence infrastructure and enterprise services.

Harrison Kim, general manager of OpenAI Korea, said at a Seoul press conference that the chip collaboration is making progress, Reuters reported. He did not provide technical specifications, a production timetable or financial terms, leaving the scope of the planned silicon unclear.

OpenAI has separately identified Samsung and SK Hynix as prospective memory suppliers for the Stargate data-center project through letters of intent. Advanced memory is a key constraint in AI systems because large models require chips that can move and store data at very high speeds.

OpenAI also said ChatGPT Enterprise usage in South Korea grew 28-fold over the past year and described Samsung as a major adopter across internal functions. Samsung declined to confirm customer-specific details in Reuters’ report. The announcement signals closer coordination, but it is not yet a product launch; manufacturing commitments, chip design and deployment milestones remain to be disclosed.
dek: OpenAI says the companies are advancing joint semiconductor work and expanding enterprise AI cooperation in South Korea.
headline: OpenAI and Samsung deepen work on next-generation chips
